title: A Rainbow Between Showers
description: Move through rain-washed archways, choosing low jumps or diagonal launches to fit the openings. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The first rain arch
rooms.lesson: Small jumps fit beneath the rain arches. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: Spray beside the blossom
rooms.lesson: Rise with the spray · leave through the side opening. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: Between the rainbow arches
rooms.lesson: Launch diagonally between the arch crowns. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The blossom arcade
rooms.lesson: The arch height changes the jump you need. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The rainbow lookout
rooms.lesson: Change direction around the garden’s high arches. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The final spring shower
rooms.lesson: Carry the spray’s lift into the final dry landing. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
